Module com.univalle.sudoku
Package com.example.sudoku.model

Interface ISudokuModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
SudokuModel
public interface ISudokuModel
Contract for the Sudoku game model. Defines all operations for board generation, state management, validation, and hint retrieval.

The board is a 6Ã—6 grid divided into six 2Ã—3 blocks. Valid cell values are integers in the range [1, 6]; 0 represents an empty cell.

    • generateNewPuzzle

      void generateNewPuzzle()
      Generates a fresh random puzzle, replacing any existing state. After this call the board will contain exactly 2 fixed clues per block.
